Definition: from G4314 and G378; to fill up further, i.e. furnish fully:--supply.
BiblicalUsage: Prosanapleroo means to fill up fully, to supply what is lacking. Paul says the service of giving not only supplies the wants of the saints but abounds in thanksgivings to God, and the brethren from Macedonia supplied what he lacked at Corinth.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that giving fills two gaps at once: the need of the saints and the silence of unthankful hearts, because supplied needs turn into praise.
